find_player.description: Find a player by name and get their id, team, position, nationality and date of birth. Returns the best match only; 'found' is false when nothing matches.
find_player.name: find_player

parameters.description: The player's full name, such as Danny Welbeck.

found.description: True when TheSportsDB found one; false leaves the rest empty.

birth_location.description: Where they were born. Only 'Get player' fills it.

description.description: A biography in English. Only 'Get player' fills it.

number.description: Their shirt number. Only 'Get player' fills it.

weight.description: Their weight, as TheSportsDB writes it.

find_team.description: Find a team by name and get its id, league, country, stadium and badge. Returns the best match only; 'found' is false when nothing matches.

get_game.description: Get a game by its id: the teams, score, status, venue and start time.
get_game.name: get_game

parameters.description: The game's TheSportsDB id, from another step's game, or the number in the address of its page on thesportsdb.com.
parameters.name: game_id

away_score.description: The away team's score. Empty until it has one.

date.description: The day it is played, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

description.description: A description in English, when there is one.

finished.description: True once the game is over.

home_score.description: The home team's score. Empty until it has one.

image_url.description: A link to an image for the game.

name.description: The game's name, e.g. 'Arsenal vs Hull City'.

starts_at.description: When it starts, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

summary.description: One line about the game: the final score once it is over, otherwise when it is.

time.description: The kick-off or start time, HH:MM:SS (UTC).

video_url.description: A link to highlights, when there are some.

winner.description: The winning team, 'Draw', or empty until it is over.
